source_snapshot.items: Check GPU details in BMC GUI/Redfish when host is OFF
source_snapshot.procedure: Power off SUT, verify GPU details in BMC WebUI, perform AC power off to deassert GPU, restore AC and keep SUT in standby.
source_snapshot.criteria: GPU details match configuration; previously displayed details are no longer present `after AC`.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 10 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; mixes optional generic chassis-off command, Redfish and operator AC/GUI steps without a precise state/timing oracle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires distinct host-off, AC-deasserted and AC-restored-standby inventory/freshness checkpoints, feed proof and recovery.

old_problem: The source clearly exercises GPU inventory across power domains but `after AC` does not identify whether disappearance is checked during complete AC loss or after AC returns to standby. Host-off auxiliary power and cached inventory further make a universal presence rule unsafe.
disposition_reason: ED-03/06/08/18/20 permit exact GPU map, canonical resources, feed topology, checkpoint presence/freshness and timeouts as signed project configuration. The method is complete when expanded into host-on baseline, host soft-off with auxiliary management power, complete-AC deassertion and AC-restored standby, each with synchronized GUI/Redfish/power evidence. Missing platform-specific presence rules block execution, not review. The ambiguous `after AC` wording remains a documented Source Conflict until the owner assigns its checkpoint; no universal cache behavior is invented.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2220, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2221 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00493-V003 / 98be56b3354f27d7 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind exact SUT/BMC firmware and every GPU by UUID/serial/slot/BDF/model/firmware plus canonical Redfish resources and matching WebUI fields.
Define four distinct checkpoints: host-on baseline, host soft-off with auxiliary power, complete all-feed AC deassertion, and AC-restored standby without host boot.
For each checkpoint sign expected GPU presence/absence, field values, freshness/cache-invalid status and readiness timeout; explicitly assign the source's `after AC` criterion.
Qualified operator or named interlocked PDU owns host/AC transitions and proves every feed/outlet; generic chassis power or guessed PDU action is prohibited.
Collect real WebUI screenshots and complete Redfish JSON at the same checkpoint and timestamp; neither channel substitutes for the other.
Stop on wrong target, BMC loss, unexpected host boot, stale/partial inventory, GPU fault or standby failure without automatic power retry.
No power action, credential use, GUI/Redfish query, log clear, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: GPU BMC WebUI/Redfish inventory across host-off, AC-deasserted and AC-restored standby states
test_case.purpose: Verify BMC GPU inventory identity, presence and freshness across host-on, host soft-off, complete AC deassertion and AC-restored standby exactly as the approved platform power-domain matrix defines.
required_package: SUT/BMC firmware and GPU UUID/serial/slot/BDF/model/firmware configuration
Canonical Redfish GPU resources/fields and matching BMC WebUI locations
PSU/feed/PDU map and definitions for host-on, host-off, complete-AC deasserted and restored-standby
Per-checkpoint presence/absence, values, cache/freshness semantics and readiness timeouts
Workload drain, maintenance and separate power authorization, final state and independent recovery
test_case.test_command: After approved workload drain, collect host-on GUI/Redfish/power baseline. Operator performs the signed host soft-off and, at its readiness point, capture complete matching WebUI and Redfish inventory. Operator or named PDU then removes every defined AC feed, records deassertion proof/dwell and any available management evidence. Restore AC without booting the host, wait for standby readiness, and capture synchronized GUI/Redfish/power evidence again. Compare each checkpoint to the signed presence/freshness matrix and finish in the approved power state without retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every checkpoint reaches its signed power/readiness state; GUI and Redfish report the exact approved GPU identities or absence with current—not stale—semantics; the source's disappearance checkpoint matches the owner-approved `after AC` interpretation; no unexpected boot, BMC/GPU fault or final-state error occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when feed/host/BMC state, complete GUI and Redfish evidence, GPU identity and freshness match the signed four-checkpoint matrix. Wrong/stale/partial inventory, unexpected presence/absence, identity mismatch, incomplete AC deassertion, unexpected boot, readiness timeout or power/GPU/BMC fault is FAIL. Missing state matrix or `after AC` checkpoint is BLOCKED at execution; one JSON sample or cached WebUI alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until GPU/resources, complete feed map, four-state presence/freshness matrix, timings, maintenance/final state and recovery are signed.
Drain workloads/data before host/AC changes; only qualified operator or named approved PDU may act and every feed must be verified.
No autonomous generic chassis/PDU action, GUI/Redfish substitution, stale-cache acceptance, log clearing or automatic cycle retry.
Stop on wrong target, BMC loss, unexpected boot, stale/partial inventory, GPU fault, incomplete deassertion or standby failure.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and SUT/BMC/GPU UUID/serial/slot/model/firmware map
Canonical WebUI/Redfish field map plus signed four-checkpoint presence/freshness/timing oracle
Approved PSU/feed/PDU map and per-state host/BMC/power transition audit
Complete per-checkpoint Redfish JSON and matching real WebUI screenshots with timestamps
Evidence distinguishing live/fresh data from cache and exact disappearance/repopulation checkpoint
SEL/host/GPU errors, final power state, abort/recovery and engineer-verdict record
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, incomplete AC removal, BMC loss, unexpected boot, stale/partial inventory or GPU/power fault, stop the sequence and preserve evidence. The authorized operator uses the independent console and signed feed restoration to reach the approved final state; do not repeat AC cycling or issue generic power commands automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The title/first criterion require details with host off, while `no longer present after AC` does not identify AC-deasserted versus AC-restored-standby. The parameterized matrix makes execution safe but the source wording remains ambiguous until project assignment.

blocked.reason: A complete four-checkpoint method is defined; platform-specific presence/freshness values and timing are runtime project configuration.
